mostWorthwhile.text: Using the pinwheel to find the wind direction was the most worthwhile step: it connected the earlier toy to a practical part of making the racer work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two bearing tubes in separate, nearly identical steps was the most repetitive passage, though the sequence was clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the pinwheel stayed in hand as a wind indicator rather than becoming part of the racer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the goals gave each construction step a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the wind-direction connection and the completed racer's run made me curious what the fair will do next. This text-only play cannot speak to the artwork or dragging.
